❯ Find out why the cloud bill jumped in September.

⏺ September's bill was $18,400, up from $11,200 in August (+$7,200).

  - $5,100 is cross-region traffic: since Sep 9 the image service reads originals from
    the us-east bucket while running in eu-west (a config change in the Sep 9 deploy).
    Example: each product page view pulls ~1.8 MB across regions; 31M views = $4,900.
  - $1,600 is a staging database left at the production size after the load test on
    Sep 14 (db.r6g.4xlarge instead of db.t4g.large).
  - $500 is normal growth.

  Fixes: point the image service at the eu-west replica (one config line), and shrink
  staging. Together about $6,700 a month. I have not changed anything.
